title: feat(refusals): one refusal names several declared reasons, each in the person's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4gWSndajcnTbbpCWXcNy9Q)_

Fixes #36877

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #37407

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：批量操作（如 HotCRM 的「提交报销」）一次拒绝多条记录时，每条原因都按用户的语言逐行显示，最后一行是总结句。
- 为什么做：拒绝语目录原来一次只能回一句，中文界面下只能给用户看英文清单；HotCRM 的报销提交卡在这里。
- 出错会怎样：只影响声明了拒绝语目录、并且一次抛出多条原因的钩子和动作；写错的原因会在保存或运行时被明确拒绝，不会把未翻译的英文漏给用户。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Ruling 7178348458 (option A, 「A 一次抛多条原因逐行翻译」), executed term by term:

- **(1) Throw shape.** A hook or `script` action body may throw `{ code, reasons: [{ reason, params? }, …] }` beside the existing single `reason`/`params` form. One reader, `refusalAddressFrom` (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`), reads the address for both run paths: the VM's `__errorInfo` channel now also carries `reasons` (JSON-cloned like `params`) and whether the key was present. A `reason` beside a `reasons` list, an empty list, or a list that is not `{ reason, params? }` elements is a `listProblem`, which is the loud fault.
- **(2) Every listed reason checked.** `declaredAnswer` (`hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`) checks each listed reason against the entry's `reasons`. One undeclared reason makes the whole throw the `500` fault naming the hook or action, the code and the reason (the existing `undeclared…ReasonAtRun` sentence). Under a code with no `reasons`, every listed reason is undeclared. At save, `hookRefusalReasonsThrownIn` already read `reason: 'x'` inside an inline list (the regex is unanchored within the throw statement); it now marks such pairs `listed: true` and also reads the assignment form `e.reasons = [{ reason: 'x' }]; throw e`. Both save checks (`HookSchema`, `ActionSchema`) judge a listed pair through one predicate, `isUndeclaredThrownReason`: a single reason is still read only under a code that declares `reasons`, as before; a listed one under every code.
- **(3) Rendering and wire.** Each line is that reason's sentence, translated and filled from its own `params` through the existing `ownerRefusalMessage`. `userMessage` is the lines joined by `\n`, then the entry's own `message` as the last line (holes from the throw's top-level `params`). The rendered lines ride the `SandboxError` as `refusals`, and every door answers them as `details.refusals: [{ reason, message }]`: one shape reader, `declaredRefusalLines` (`packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, the `candidates` precedent), read by `resolveThrownHttpError` (the `/actions` door, MCP `run_action`, the dispatcher) and by `mapDataError`'s `userMessage` rider (the `/data` door). The VM never sets `refusals`: only the catalogue does, so a body cannot hand the wire a list it did not render.
- **(4) Parity.** The in-process hook handler reads its throw through the same `refusalAddressFrom` and builds the same error shape (`code`, `status`, `userMessage`, `refusals`), so the two paths answer byte-identically (pinned below).
- **(5)** The catalogue entry schema and the translation keys are unchanged.

The surface was widened by the zone before the edit (claim amendment 7179332961) to `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts` and `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`: each door builds `details` from a closed set of fields read there, so term (3) could not reach the wire from `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/**` alone.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`: the body path (en and zh-CN lines, per-line params, closing line, `details.refusals` on `/data` and through `thrownAnswerOf`, the `e.reasons = […]` form); seven fault cases (undeclared listed reason, listed reason under a code with no `reasons`, both forms, empty, element without `reason`, non-list, list `params`), each a `500` with no `userMessage` and no `details`; the parity pin (body vs in-process handler, `JSON.stringify` equal on `mapDataError` and `thrownAnswerOf`, en and zh-CN) plus the same faults in-process; CONTROL: a single reason carries no `details.refusals` on either path.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`: through the real `/actions` door, translated lines plus `error.details.refusals`, and `actionsDoorAnswerOf` (the MCP reader) agrees; an undeclared listed reason is the fault naming the action.
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/action-refusals.test.ts`: the reader's listed pairs (inline and assignment), what it leaves to run time, the predicate, the save refusal for an undeclared listed reason and for one under a code with no `reasons`, CONTROL: a single reason under such a code still saves.
- `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.test.ts`: `declaredRefusalLines` shape reading (five no-list cases, copies only `reason`/`message`) and both door compositions.

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`, the listed-reason check `if (!reasons || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(reasons, line.reason)) {` replaced by `if (/* ABLATED_36877 */ false) {` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 5f2aba5d → ae48d69f): 3 failed / 50 passed, the three `[#36877]` undeclared-reason cases on both paths. Restored: blob equals HEAD (5f2aba5d), `git diff HEAD` empty. The runtime tests import the module from `src/`, so no rebuild was needed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `/data` keeps bounding `userMessage` at 500 characters (#5423); a long list loses nothing on `details.refusals`.
- The console still shows the first sentence with the rest behind "More"; the list rendering is ruling term 6, follow-up #37403.
- A `reasons` key a body threw beside a declared code used to be ignored (the card's probe table). It is now answered, or is the loud fault when it is not a readable list. Nothing that saves today is refused unless its source spells a literal `reasons: [{ reason: 'x' }]` naming an undeclared reason, which the card measured as silently ignored before.
- MCP: `actionsDoorAnswerOf` carries `details.refusals`; whether the MCP tool result renders `details` was not re-measured (analysis confidence gap (c)).

## Verification

Derived gate list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 97 commands) run locally:

- 94 exit 0.
- `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`: red on the first run (a `refusalError(code)` helper read as an unresolved code stamp); fixed in `e8d60127` by building the error inline at both sites as before; re-run exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED, prerequisites of this checkout, not of the diff: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3, its pinned positive control needs an unshallowed clone; it grades the script, which this PR does not touch); `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, needs the whole workspace built; CI's Build Core runs it).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `api-surface/` and `export-origins/` were stale (new exports) and are regenerated in this PR; re-check green.

The changeset carries the two declaration lines only (`a2558d18`). CI's check-runs are the authority for every family; dogfood is not owed locally (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.test.ts -t 36877` — expect every `[#36877]` case green, including the parity pin.

Read first: `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts` (`declaredAnswer`, the list branch), `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` (`refusalAddressFrom` and the reject handler's new `reasons` clone), `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts` (`declaredRefusalLines`).
